mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_visitor (b_id, visitor_id, `name`, tel, unit, no, invitation_id, id_card, license, operate) VALUES (#{bId}, #{visitorId}, #{name}, #{tel}, #{unit}, #{no}, #{invitationId}, #{idCard}, #{license}, #{operate})

INSERT INTO visitor(visitor_id, `name`, tel, unit, no, invitation_id, id_card, license, b_id, status_cd) SELECT visitor_id, `name`, tel, unit, no, invitation_id, id_card, license, b_id, '0' FROM business_visitor WHERE b_id = #{bId} AND operate = #{operate}
